k25464768.notes: Blue advance direction sign: green motorway panel (Budapest, Wien / Brno, Žilina) straight ahead, white panel Petržalka, right-turn panel Devín / Karlova Ves. The vertical Chinese characters 城堡 on a restaurant sign above are a distractor; small parking guidance signs at lower left are distractors.

k31134986.notes: Orange fascia of a betting shop with the 'niké' logo box at left and grey italic 'stávková kancelária'; repeated on a small orange box on the ground floor. Distractors: 'PRÍSTAV / PASSENGER PORT' direction sign at right, Fio banka, MARTINI and LEKÁREŇ signs at left, a JCDecaux poster. Taken through a windscreen; mirror intrudes at top right.

p269c250db2.notes: Outdoor interpretive board on the bunker trail in Petržalka; only the title bar is the target. The body text, map labels (NEMECKO, POLSKO, RAKÚSKO, MAĎARSKO, RUMUNSKO) and the graffiti on the left post are distractors.

p38eb131c9d.notes: Green window-top banner of a tiger-nut drink café with a tree logo. The side panel ('Gluten free / Lactose free / High fibre / Unsweetened / Vegan') and the vertical background words are distractors.

p3d4d6fc771.reason: both fascia names are cut off (left by the frame, right by tree leaves); no complete name

p45ca1680dd.notes: Black board with the gold script logo 'Cafe Mayer' inside a circle; the lower lines ('Cafe / Cake shop / Own production / Cakes on order') are partly hidden by the top hat of the silver Schöne Náci statue in front, and the small script lines beside the logo are not legible. The statue is a sculpture, not a person.

p7d5fbb5051.reason: worn bronze memorial plaque about a person; several raised letters unreadable, no mappable place as target

pa4e323eb0a.reason: night chalkboard menu (Avocado toast, Latte, Prosecco), menu only

pb40228e9aa.notes: Marble memorial plaque with gilt carved letters on a building (Pálffy palace, Old Town); frontal and sharp. Top lines are smaller and the gilt is worn but legible.

pebacafa805.notes: Bronze letters on the plinth of the Anton Bernolák bust; the subject's face is a sculpture. A small 'Chránený strom' tag on the tree at left is a distractor.

c127083968.notes: Bus-stop sign on road I/66: blue-framed panel with operator name above a bus pictogram and SAD logo (tiny caption 'Slovenská autobusová doprava Zvolen, a. s.' under the logo), and a separate white plate with the stop name 'Brusno'. Timetable sheet on the panel below is too small to read. Car on the road at left is incidental.

c127083970.reason: near-duplicate: wider view of the same Brusno bus-stop sign as c127083968

c155963793.notes: Bratislava, Panská street: target is the black arched fascia with gold letters over the right shop window, seen at an upward angle (JANTAR is Slovak for amber). Busy distractors: sticker-covered sub-plate under a warning triangle, '...GARNET' fascia partly hidden by the sign, window band 'HODINKY WATCHES' with TISSOT/TIMEX logos, window text '...O, JANTAR, GRANAT, CRYSTAL / ...OKAMY POLODRAHOKAMY'. Street plate at top-left '[P]ANSKÁ UL. / I' has its first letter hidden by a lamp bracket, with house numbers '1' and 'I. 251'.

c197773837.notes: Tatra Electric Railway platform sign: station name on top, then two columns of next stations (left column with left arrow: Pod Lesom / Veľký Slavkov / Poprad - Tatry; right column with right arrow: Tatranská Polianka / Vyšné Hágy / Štrbské Pleso); lines listed row by row. Small white plate below 'KOĽAJ č.4' (track no. 4). Small stickers on the board are distractors.

c49215751.reason: wrought-iron trade sign (scythe and ornaments) with no text

c4924189.notes: Dvory nad Žitavou (Udvard): blue diamond panel with condor logo painted on a pink bakery wall; Slovak name and product line, Hungarian product line below. The sign is small in a whole-building photo but legible.

c92428845.notes: Illuminated blue platform-canopy sign with yellow caps at dusk; red-white ZSSK coaches and a blue-yellow locomotive behind (small coach markings are distractors).
